_comment: L1 toggles IR <-> Wide. 'thermal' and 'standard' both fire L1 — user picks which tab represents the next state. L2 toggles Zoom <-> Wide. L3 drops a marker.

thermal.description: L1 — fires thermal toggle (if currently Wide, switches to IR)

standard.description: L1 — fires thermal toggle (if currently IR, switches back to Wide)

toggle_ir.description: L1 — same as thermal/standard, named for legacy reference

toggle_zoom.description: L2 — same as zoom, named for legacy reference

range.description: L2 placeholder — will be remapped to actual rangefinder activation once UI is mapped

drop_marker.description: L3 — drops a navigation marker / waypoint pin
